title: Senior Medical Biller / RCM Specialist - eClinicalWorks Required - Pain Management & Workers’ Comp
description:
Genesis Pain Clinic is a US-based interventional pain management practice looking for a full-time Senior Medical Biller / Revenue Cycle Management Specialist.



Schedule:

Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM US Central Time

40 hours per week

Full-time, dedicated role



Pay:

$7-$11 USD per hour, depending on verified experience



This is a hands-on provider-side medical billing role. We are looking for someone who already has real US medical billing experience and can work independently inside eClinicalWorks.



This is not a general VA role.

This is not an entry-level billing role.

This is not a flexible-hours or part-time role.



The right person should be able to review claims, identify billing problems, work denials, follow up with payers, document clearly, and keep the revenue cycle moving without needing constant step-by-step instructions.



--------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



- Minimum 3 to 5 years of US medical billing / RCM experience

- Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience required

- Provider-side outpatient clinic billing experience preferred

- Experience with claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denials, appeals, reconsiderations, and AR follow-up

- Comfortable using payer portals and calling insurance companies

- Comfortable with CPT, ICD-10, modifiers, units, place of service, and authorization requirements

- Able to document payer calls, reference numbers, claim notes, and next follow-up dates

- Able to work full-time during US Central Time business hours

- Reliable internet, backup internet, and backup power required



--------------------------------------------------

STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



- Pain management billing

- Interventional procedure billing

- Workers' Compensation billing

- Orthopedic, spine, neurology, PM&R, or specialty billing

- Medicare, Medicare Advantage, commercial insurance, and out-of-network billing

- Prior authorizations for procedures

- Medical necessity appeals

- Payment posting and underpayment review

- Coding certification or strong coding knowledge



--------------------------------------------------

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

--------------------------------------------------



You should be able to independently handle most of the following:



- Verification of benefits / eligibility

- Prior authorization / pre-authorization

- Claim submission

- Claim scrubbing

- Clearinghouse rejection correction

- Payment posting from ERA/EOB

- Manual payment posting

- Contractual adjustments

- Denial management

- Corrected claims

- Appeals and reconsiderations

- AR follow-up

- Medical records requests

- Payer portal follow-up

- Workers' Compensation claim follow-up

- Daily productivity reporting



--------------------------------------------------

eCLINICALWORKS REQUIREMENT

--------------------------------------------------



Hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience is required.



Please do not apply if you only used eCW for scheduling, only watched eCW videos, or only have basic exposure. We need someone who understands the billing side of eCW.



You should be comfortable with eCW workflows such as:



- Claim review

- Claim submission

- Claim status

- Claim notes

- Payment posting

- Denial tracking

- Corrected claims

- AR follow-up

- Attaching or referencing payer documentation



--------------------------------------------------

PAIN MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



Pain management billing experience is a strong advantage.



Examples of procedures we may bill include:



- Epidural steroid injections

- Medial branch blocks

- Radiofrequency ablation

- SI joint injections

- Trigger point injections

- Large joint injections

- Fluoroscopy-guided procedures

- Ultrasound-guided procedures

- Urine drug testing



You do not need to know every pain procedure on day one, but you must be comfortable learning payer rules, CPT/modifier issues, authorization requirements, and documentation requirements.



--------------------------------------------------

WORKERS' COMPENSATION

--------------------------------------------------



Workers' Compensation billing experience is strongly preferred.



Helpful experience includes:



- Claim numbers

- Date of injury

- Adjusters

- Nurse case managers

- Authorizations

- EOR/EOB review

- Records requests

- Underpayment follow-up

- Reconsiderations

- Appeals

- Payer-specific Workers' Compensation processes



--------------------------------------------------

FULL-TIME DEDICATED ROLE / NO OVEREMPLOYMENT

--------------------------------------------------



This is a full-time dedicated role during our scheduled work hours.



During paid working hours, you may not:



- Work for another client

- Work for another agency

- Work another job

- Monitor another client's messages

- Keep another work laptop open

- Attend another client's meetings

- Run another time tracker

- Subcontract your work

- Share logins



Before hire, you must disclose all current clients, employers, agencies, freelance work, and recurring paid obligations.



Another job that overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time is disqualifying.



This role is not compatible with overemployment, double-jobbing, mouse jigglers, fake activity, or time padding.



--------------------------------------------------

TIME TRACKING AND COMMUNICATION

--------------------------------------------------



Time Doctor will be required.



We may review:



- Screenshots

- Activity levels

- App usage

- Website usage

- eCW activity

- Payer portal activity

- Teams responsiveness

- Daily output reports



Time Doctor activity alone is not enough. Paid time must match real billing output.



Manual time is not allowed unless approved.



During scheduled hours, you must be reachable on Microsoft Teams. Normal response expectation is within 5 minutes unless you are on a payer call, in a meeting, or have already documented why you are unavailable.



--------------------------------------------------

DAILY REPORTING

--------------------------------------------------



At the end of each workday, you will send a short productivity report showing what was completed, what is pending, and what is blocked.



Your report may include:



- Claims submitted

- Claims corrected

- Denials worked

- Appeals or reconsiderations submitted

- Payments posted

- Manual payments posted

- AR accounts worked

- Prior authorizations submitted or followed up

- VOBs completed

- Payer calls completed

- Reference numbers obtained

- Issues needing provider or administrator review



--------------------------------------------------

SELECTION PROCESS

--------------------------------------------------



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete:



- Written screening questions

- Short video interview

- Live eClinicalWorks / RCM technical interview

- Live screen-share workflow test

- Paid practical billing test

- 5-day paid evaluation period

- 30-day probationary period



We are not hiring based only on interview confidence. We are hiring based on demonstrated skill, reliability, integrity, and actual work output.



--------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------



Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions.



The first line of your application must be:



ECW RCM DEDICATED



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years of US provider-side medical billing / RCM experience do you have? Which specialties have you billed for?



2. How many years of hands-on eClinicalWorks billing experience do you have? List the exact billing tasks you personally performed inside eCW.



3. Which RCM tasks can you perform independently?

Examples: VOB, prior auth, claim submission, claim scrubbing, payment posting, manual posting, denial management, appeals, AR follow-up, records requests.



4. Describe a denial you fixed from start to finish. What was the denial, what did you check, what action did you take, and how did you document it?



5. Explain your payment posting experience. Have you posted ERAs/EOBs and manual payments? Have you identified underpayments, duplicate posting, contractual adjustments, or recoupments?



6. Describe your Workers' Compensation billing experience, if any.



7. Which payer portals and clearinghouse portals have you personally used?

Examples: Availity, UHC, Optum, Medicare, Medicaid, BCBS, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, Workers' Compensation portals, TriZetto, Office Ally, or other clearinghouses.



8. Are you currently working for any other client, employer, agency, or freelance project? If yes, list your exact schedule and whether it overlaps with 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central Time.



9. Confirm that you are comfortable with Time Doctor, screenshots, activity tracking, daily productivity reports, Teams responsiveness, and live screen-sharing when requested.



10. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



Mini Test Question:



A claim for a lumbar radiofrequency ablation is denied for CO-50, medical necessity. Walk me through what you would check before d
 whether to submit an appeal, corrected claim, or records request.

This is not an entry-level healthcare admin role.

This is not basic insurance verification.



This is a credentialing, payer enrollment, provider enrollment, and compliance tracking role.



We are a small specialty medical clinic with one physician provider and one primary clinic location. We need someone who can organize and maintain credentialing, payer enrollment, CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, license renewals, DEA renewals, hospital/surgery center privileges, and payer follow-up.



Initial workload may be 5-10 hours per week while we clean up existing files, update profiles, and resolve open credentialing issues.



Long-term maintenance may average 5-10 hours per month, depending on payer recredentialing, license renewals, hospital privileges, and new enrollment needs.



Pay:

$8-$12 USD per hour depending on verified experience.



Schedule:

Part-time, flexible schedule.

Must be available for scheduled check-ins.

Paid time must be focused only on our credentialing work.



--------------------------------------------------

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

------------------------------------------
to 5 years of US healthcare credentialing or provider enrollment experience

- Hands-on CAQH experience

- Hands-on PECOS / Medicare provider enrollment experience

- NPPES / NPI update experience

- Commercial payer enrollment experience

- Experience submitting and tracking payer applications

- Experience following up with payers by portal,
, and phone

- Experience maintaining credentialing trackers or spreadsheets

- Strong written English

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to work independently

- High confidentiality and professionalism



--------------------------------------------------

STRONGLY PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

--------------------------------------------------



- Physician practice credentialing

- Specialty clinic credentialing

- Pain management, anesthesia, orthopedic, spine, PM&R, neurology, ASC, or procedural-specialty experience

- Hospital or surgery center privileging

- Medicare and Medicaid enrollment

- Commercial payer enrollment with BCBS, UHC/Optum, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, and regional payers

- EFT / ERA / EDI enrollment

- Payer contracting support

- Recredentialing and revalidation

- Workers' Compensation network enrollment

- Experience handling sensitive provider disclosures, malpractice history, training gaps, licensure questions, or application explanations

- CPES, CPCS, CPMSM, CPB, CPC, or other healthcare credentialing/billing certification



Certifications are preferred but not required.

Real hands-on credentialing experience matters more than certificates.



--------------------------------------------------

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

--------------------------------------------------



You may be responsible for:



- Maintaining CAQH profile

- Uploading and updating CAQH documents

- CAQH attestations / re-attestations

- Authorizing payer access in CAQH

- Maintaining PECOS / Medicare enrollment information

- Tracking Medicare revalidations

- Maintaining NPPES / NPI information

- Updating taxonomy, address, contact, and practice information

- Submitting commercial payer enrollment applications

- Tracking payer application status

- Following up with payers until approval

- Confirming payer effective dates

- Supporting payer contracting paperwork

- Supporting EFT / ERA / EDI setup

- Helping connect payer approvals to billing/clearinghouse workflow

- Tracking payer portal logins and status updates

- Maintaining a credentialing tracker

- Maintaining a license / DEA / CME / malpractice renewal calendar

- Assisting with hospital and surgery center privilege applications

- Tracking hospital reappointment deadlines

- Organizing peer references and privilege documents

- Organizing malpractice insurance certificates and loss runs

- Organizing board certification, CME, ACLS/BLS, and other documents

- Organizing sensitive disclosure documents for provider review

- Preparing weekly or monthly status reports



--------------------------------------------------

CONFIDENTIALITY REQUIREMENT

--------------------------------------------------



This role involves sensitive physician credentialing information.



You may see private information related to medical licenses, malpractice history, training history, insurance applications, hospital privileges, DEA registration, government portals, and payer applications.



You must be extremely confidential.



You may not:



- Share clinic or provider information

- Save documents to your personal computer

- Upload documents to your personal Google Drive, Dropbox, or

- Forward clinic documents to outside accounts

- Upload clinic documents into ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, or any outside AI tool without written approval

- Share logins

- Subcontract the work

- Allow another person to access our documents or portals



A confidentiality agreement and HIPAA/BAA may be required before access is granted.



--------------------------------------------------

SENSITIVE DISCLOSURE RULE

--------------------------------------------------



Some credentialing applications ask sensitive yes/no questions about malpractice claims, training history, licensure history, hospital privileges, investigations, or professional issues.



You are not expected to make legal or professional judgment calls.



Your responsibility is to:



- Flag every sensitive disclosure question

- Organize the requested information

- Draft a clear factual summary if asked

- Send the question and draft to the physician for review

- Wait for physician approval before submission

- Never guess

- Never hide information

- Never answer a sensitive question without approval

- Never submit an application with incomplete or inaccurate disclosure information



Accuracy, honesty, and confidentiality are mandatory.



--------------------------------------------------

TRACKING AND REPORTING

--------------------------------------------------



Every application or follow-up must be documented.



Your credentialing tracker should include:



- Payer or facility name

- Portal used

- Application type

- Date started

- Date submitted

- Confirmation number

- Reference number

- Contact person

- Current status

- Missing items

- Next follow-up date

- Approval date

- Effective date

- EFT / ERA / EDI status if applicable

- Notes and blockers



A short weekly status report will be required.



Weekly report should include:



- Applications submitted

- Applications pending

- Payers or facilities contacted

- Reference numbers obtained

- Missing documents needed from physician

- Sensitive disclosure questions needing physician review

- Renewals coming due

- Problems or delays

- Next week priorities



--------------------------------------------------

WORK STYLE

--------------------------------------------------



This is a part-time role, but paid time must be focused on our work.



During paid working time:



- You must work only on our credentialing tasks

- You may not bill time while working for another client

- You may not subcontract the work

- You must document actual work completed

- You must update the credentialing tracker

- You must be available for scheduled check-ins

- You must be able to explain what you completed



This role is best for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, experienced, confidential, and able to work independently.



--------------------------------------------------

DO NOT APPLY IF

--------------------------------------------------



Please do not apply if:



- You have no US healthcare credentialing experience

- You have never used CAQH

- You have never used PECOS

- You do not understand provider enrollment

- You only know insurance verification

- You only know medical billing but not credentialing

- You cannot maintain a detailed tracker

- You are not comfortable with sensitive confidential information

- You need to be trained from the beginning

- You cannot follow up with payers consistently

- You cannot work independently

- You plan to subcontract this role

- You are not willing to complete a live screen-share skills test



--------------------------------------------------

SELECTION PROCESS

--------------------------------------------------



Qualified applicants may be asked to complete:



- Written screening questions

- Short video interview

- Live screen-share workflow test

- Credentialing tracker review

- Paid trial task

- 30-day probationary period



We are not hiring based on interview confidence.



We are hiring based on demonstrated credentialing skill, organization, confidentiality, and follow-through.



--------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

--------------------------------------------------



Your application will only be considered if you follow these instructions.



The first line of your application must be:



CREDENTIALING EXPERT - CAQH PECOS



Then answer these questions:



1. How many years of US healthcare credentialing or provider enrollment experience do you have?



2. Have you personally worked in CAQH? Describe exactly what tasks you performed.



3. Have you personally worked in PECOS? Describe exactly what tasks you performed.



4. Have you personally updated NPPES / NPI information? What types of updates have you done?



5. Which commercial payers have you credentialed providers with?

Examples: BCBS, UHC/Optum, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, Medicare Advantage plans, Medicaid plans, regional payers.



6. Have you handled hospital or surgery center privilege applications? If yes, describe your experience.



7. Have you handled Medicare revalidation, Medicaid enrollment, or payer recredentialing? Give examples.



8. Have you handled EFT / ERA / EDI enrollment after payer approval? Explain your workflow.



9. What credentialing tracker or spreadsheet have you used? Describe the columns you would include.



10. Describe a time when a payer application was stuck, returned incomplete, or delayed. What did you do to fix it?



11. Have you ever handled sensitive provider disclosures such as malpractice history, training gaps, licensure questions, or disciplinary questions? How did you handle confidentiality and provider approval?



12. What certifications do you have, if any?

Examples: CPES, CPCS, CPMSM, CPB, CPC, healthcare administration, medical billing, credentialing training.



13. Are you currently working for other clients? If yes, list your current schedule and confirm that you will not bill us while working for another client.



14. What is your requested hourly rate in USD?



15. Are you available for a live screen-share test where you walk through a sample CAQH / PECOS / payer enrollment workflow?



--------------------------------------------------

MINI TEST QUESTION

--------------------------------------------------



A solo physician is already in-network with some payers, but the CAQH profile, NPPES profile, malpractice certificate, DEA certificate, and payer enrollment tracker may be outdated.



Walk me through exactly how you would audit and clean up the credentialing file during the first 30 days.



Your answer should mention CAQH, PECOS, NPPES, payer applications, commercial payers, Medicare, DEA, state license, malpractice insurance, hospital privileges, EFT / ERA / EDI, credentialing tracker, missing documents, and follow-up schedule.

title: Executive Assistant to the COO
description:
Executive Assistant to the COO

Full-Time · Remote · US Pacific Hours



 About Us

We are a California-based US company. We move fast, we use AI tools across everything we do, and we're building a small, high-trust team. We're looking for a sharp, reliable Executive Assistant to work directly with our COO.



About the Role

You'll be the operational right hand to our COO — the person who keeps the inbox, calendar, customer and investor coordination, events, recruiting logistics, and daily operations running without friction. This is a high-trust role: you'll handle sensitive customer, investor, and company information, so discretion and reliability are non-negotiable.



This is a long-term, full-time position for someone proactive and detail-obsessed who thinks a step ahead. You won't just execute tasks — you'll protect the COO's time, catch things before they slip, and bring order to a busy schedule.



We are AI-native and strongly prefer candidates comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, AI note-takers, automations) as part of daily work.



What You'll Do

Your responsibilities will grow as you build trust. Core areas include:



Inbox & Communications

- Triage the inbox daily; surface what's urgent and important

- Group non-urgent items for batch review

- Draft replies for routine
s; follow up on open threads

- Research context on senders or topics when needed



Calendar, Focus Time & Travel

- Own the calendar: schedule, batch similar meetings, defend focus blocks

- Politely push back on or decline low-value meetings

- Coordinate LA-SF travel and event travel (flights, hotels, ground transport)

- Book restaurants and venues for customer and investor meetups



Customer Call Support

- Call leads the day before and again on the day of their meeting to confirm they will attend; if a lead can't make it, remove them from the calendar and reschedule

- Trigger our Airtable automation and surface the prep doc before each call

- Send templated post-call follow-ups from the CRM

- Turn AI note-taker output into clean, structured summaries (key quotes, FAQs, cross-call learnings)

- Organize recordings and notes into Drive



Investor & Fundraising Coordination

- Schedule investor meetings using set time-window rules; send calendar invites

- Assemble pre-call prep docs and drop them in the right Drive folder before each call

- Keep the COO on schedule for the monthly investor update; send it to the investor list only after the COO has written and approved it

- Track and remind on important investor follow-ups



Events

- Source relevant customer- and investor-facing events

- Register us and add to the calendar

- Build prep cards on who to meet

- Help coordinate intros before and follow-ups after



Recruiting Coordination

- Schedule candidate calls

- Send standard rejection
s

- Do light pre-interview research on candidates

- Maintain the sourcing list



Legal & Vendor Coordination

- Track back-and-forth with our law firm and remind the COO to respond quickly (administrative tracking only — no legal work)

- Maintain a list of paid subscriptions; flag renewals before auto-charge; surface and (with approval) cancel unused tools

- Coordinate with our bookkeeper rather than duplicate work



CRM, Drive & File Organization

- Keep the Airtable CRM clean: log interactions, add contacts, update status fields

- Organize Drive across customer, investor, internal, and legal folders

- Maintain clean file-naming and folder structure



Social Media Support

- Monitor LinkedIn, X, and YouTube for our company accounts and leadership

- Surface DMs and comments that need a response

- Draft responses and post with approval; escalate anything sensitive with a suggested draft



Industry Intel Briefing

- Deliver a daily or weekly digest of construction/AEC industry news, competitor moves, and updates on our customers and prospects — in a 5-minute skim format



Who We're Looking For

- 2+ years experience as an EA, VA, or operations assistant, ideally supporting a founder or executive

- Excellent written English AND strong spoken English — you will be making confirmation calls to US-based leads, so a clear, professional phone manner is required

- Extremely organized and detail-oriented — you don't let things slip

- Proactive and confident enough to defend a calendar and push back on low-value requests, politely

- Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information

- Comfortable with AI tools and quick to learn new software

- Reliable internet with a backup connection

- Able to work full-time on US Pacific hours (overnight in the Philippines)



Work Setup

- Full-time, 48 hours/week, Monday to Saturday

- Hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM US Pacific Time

- 100% remote, work from home

- Tools: Google Workspace, Airtable, 
, Hubstaff, Tailscale VPN, AI note-takers

- Your time is tracked with Hubstaff during working hours

- Your screen and camera must be shared on 
 during all working hours



Compensation

- $3-$5/hour USD, depending on experience

- Paid monthly via Wise — payment is made 15 days after the first of the following month

- Long-term role with room to grow in responsibility and rate



How to Apply

Please follow these steps carefully — applications that don't follow them will not be reviewed:



1. Start your application with the word **COMPASS** so we know you read the full post.

2. Include a short note about your relevant EA/VA experience and why US hours work for you.

3. Attach your resume.

4. Record a short Loom video (2-3 minutes), camera on, no script. Tell us who you are, walk us through your relevant experience, and share one example of a time you managed a busy executive's inbox or calendar — or caught something important before it slipped.



By applying, please confirm you understand and agree to:

- Sharing your screen AND keeping your camera on for all hours you are working, with your time tracked by Hubstaff

- Working US Pacific hours, Monday to Saturday (overnight in the Philippines)

- Monthly payment via Wise, made 15 days after the first of the following month



We review every complete application and respond to strong candidates. We look forward to meeting you.

title: Remote Automotive Bookkeeper & Parts Reconciliation Specialist
description:
We are a busy independent auto repair shop in Slidell, Louisiana, specializing in gas and diesel light/medium-duty vehicles. We are seeking a remote Automotive Bookkeeper & Parts Reconciliation Specialist to join our team.



This is not a general bookkeeping position. We need someone with prior auto repair shop bookkeeping experience who understands how parts invoices, vendor credits, returns, repair orders, Tekmetric, and QuickBooks Online all connect.



We work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST. This position requires someone willing to work our business hours, which will likely be a PHP graveyard shift. During scheduled work hours, you must be exclusively available to our shop.



The ideal candidate can handle both bookkeeping/reconciliation duties and parts ticket entry inside Tekmetric. If you are only experienced with automotive bookkeeping, parts reconciliation, and QuickBooks Online, we may consider a part-time role. If you can also enter parts tickets into Tekmetric accurately, this may be a full-time position.



Prior auto repair shop bookkeeping experience is required. Tekmetric experience is required. QuickBooks Online experience is required.



Duties:



* Enter parts invoices/tickets into Tekmetric

* Match vendor parts invoices to the correct repair orders

* Reconcile parts invoices, returns, credits, and vendor statements

* Verify parts costs are accurately reflected on repair orders

* Track and follow up on missing vendor credits

* Communicate with parts vendors regarding returns, credits, invoice discrepancies, and statement issues

* Reconcile all parts vendor accounts

* Prepare a list of accounts payable for owner review and payment

* Enter daily journal entries in QuickBooks Online

* Help ensure Tekmetric and QuickBooks Online stay accurate

* Identify discrepancies between vendor invoices, returns, repair orders, and accounting records

* Communicate clearly with the team when parts costs, credits, or invoices do not match

* Keep organized notes and documentation for bookkeeping and reconciliation issues

* Assist with back-office accounting and administrative tasks as needed



Experience Required:



* Prior auto repair shop bookkeeping experience

* Experience with Tekmetric

* Experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience reconciling parts invoices, returns, credits, and vendor statements

* Understanding of how parts costs affect repair order profitability

* Ability to identify missing credits, duplicate invoices, wrong costs, and unmatched returns

* Strong attention to detail

* Strong English reading and writing skills

* Ability to communicate clearly with vendors and internal tea
mbers

* Ability to work independently and follow established processes



Preferred Experience:

* Experience entering parts tickets/invoices into Tekmetric

* Experience preparing accounts payable lists for owner/manager review

* Experience with automotive parts vendors

* Experience working remotely for a US-based auto repair shop

* Experience supporting daily bookkeeping workflows for an independent repair shop



Hiring Process & Must Haves:

* Will require video interviews

* Must have prior auto repair shop bookkeeping experience

* Must have Tekmetric experience

* Must have QuickBooks Online experience

* Must be fluent in English reading and writing

* Must be comfortable communicating with vendors when needed

* Must be willing to work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST

* Must have a Windows computer with current Windows OS

* Must have at least 16GB RAM

* Must have 2 monitors

* Must have reliable high-speed internet with backup connection

* Must have a noise-cancelling headset

* Must have a quiet workspace

* Must have voice chat ability for interviews and during work hours

* Must have a Payoneer account

* Must be willing to complete a bookkeeping/reconciliation skills test

* Mandatory use of Timeproof



To Apply:



When applying, please use the
 subject:



“I know how to reconcile auto repair parts and bookkeeping”



Please include:



* Your resume

* Your MS Teams ID

* A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

* Links to reviews from previous employers, if available

* A short explanation of your auto repair shop bookkeeping experience



Please answer the questions below:



1. How many years of auto repair shop bookkeeping experience do you have?

2. Have you used Tekmetric before? If yes, what tasks did you perform in Tekmetric?

3. Have you entered parts invoices or parts tickets into Tekmetric?

4. Have you reconciled parts invoices, returns, credits, and vendor statements before?

5. Have you used QuickBooks Online before? If yes, what tasks did you perform in QuickBooks Online?

6. Have you entered daily journal entries in QuickBooks Online?

7. Have you prepared accounts payable lists for owner or manager review?

8. Which automotive parts vendors have you worked with?

9. Are you comfortable contacting vendors about missing credits, return issues, invoice discrepancies, or statement questions?

10. Are you applying for the full-time role that includes Tekmetric parts ticket entry, or the part-time bookkeeping/reconciliation role only?



This role is for someone who understands that parts accounting is not just data entry. Missing credits, wrong invoice costs, duplicate charges, and unreconciled returns can quietly eat profit. We need someone detail-oriented who can help keep Tekmetric, QuickBooks Online, vendor statements, and parts records accurate.

title: WordPress Web Developer (Elementor Pro) Project-Based with Pathway to Part-Time/Full-Time | Remote
description:
About This Role

We are an Australian digital marketing agency that builds professional WordPress websites for local business clients across Australia. We are looking for a skilled Elementor Pro developer to join our team on fixed-price project work, with a genuine pathway to regular part-time hours and potentially full-time employment as our agency grows.

We start with fixed-price projects so both sides can build trust and assess the fit properly. There is no set number of projects before any transition happens. It takes as long as it takes, and when both sides are confident in the working relationship, the conversation about ongoing work happens naturally.



How It Works

Stage 1: Fixed-Price Project Work

We agree on the scope and price upfront before any work begins. You complete the project, we review, provide feedback, and pay promptly on completion. This continues for as long as it needs to.



Typical projects include:



A full multi-page WordPress build from our HTML prototype and written build map

Single page or template builds

Bug fixes or troubleshooting jobs on existing sites



Stage 2: Regular Part-Time Retainer



When the working relationship is established and the fit is clear on both sides, we move to a set number of hours per week at an agreed monthly rate. Work becomes more predictable and consistent for both of us.

Stage 3: Full-Time (As the Agency Grows)

As our client base expands, we want a developer who grows with us. Full-time hours are a genuine possibility for the right person over time.



What You Will Be Building



Each project is a multi-page WordPress website built to a detailed HTML prototype and written build map that we provide. You do not need to design from scratch. Your job is to translate our approved designs into a pixel-accurate, fully functional WordPress site using Elementor Pro.



A typical build includes:



Homepage with hero, animated counters, card sections, testimonials, and enquiry forms

5 to 15 inner pages including service pages, suburb or location pages, article pages, and a contact page

Global header and footer via Theme Builder

Elementor Pro forms connected to
 via WP Mail SMTP

Schema markup configured via Rank Math or Yoast

Mobile responsiveness checked and confirmed on all pages

Page speed basics including image compression, clean plugin structure, and no unnecessary code





Skills and Experience Required

Must have:



WordPress and Elementor Pro with a minimum of 80 to 100 completed builds

Hello Elementor theme setup and configuration

Elementor Pro Theme Builder for headers, footers, and single templates

Elementor Pro Form widget with SMTP integration

Essential Addons for Elementor including card hover effects and box widgets

Google Fonts integration and global font and colour setup

Rank Math or Yoast SEO plugin configuration

ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) and Custom Post Type UI

WP Mail SMTP setup and troubleshooting

Responsive design and mobile breakpoint adjustments in Elementor

Ability to read and follow an HTML prototype and written build map accurately

Clear written English communication and proactive updates



Nice to have:



Experience with real estate or local service business websites

Familiarity with JSON-LD schema markup

Basic knowledge of Core Web Vitals and page speed optimisation

Experience with WooCommerce or membership plugins





What We Provide



We are an organised client. When you start a project with us you receive:



A complete HTML prototype of every page for visual reference

A written Elementor Build Map with section-by-section instructions

Global colour codes, font names, and design tokens already defined

Form field specifications written out in full

Schema markup values ready to copy into the SEO plugin

A clear point of contact who responds promptly

Payment via PayPal or Wise, promptly on project completion



You will never be handed a vague brief and left to figure it out. We do the thinking upfront so you can build efficiently.



What We Are Looking For in You

Beyond technical skills, we want someone who:



Takes ownership and flags problems early rather than going quiet

Follows a brief carefully and asks questions when something is unclear

Builds sites the right way with no pasted CSS hacks, no bloated plugins, and no custom code where native Elementor widgets will do the job

Communicates proactively and honestly about timelines

Wants to grow with a team over the long term, not just pick up a one-off gig

Is proud of the quality of their work





Compensation

Project stage: Fixed price agreed per project before work begins. We price fairly for the scope involved.

Ongoing stage: Monthly retainer based on agreed hours per week once the relationship is established.

We are not looking for the cheapest option. We are looking for the most reliable option at a fair price, and we pay accordingly.

Please include your expected per-project rate in your application. Applications without a rate indication will not be prioritised.



How to Apply

Please send us the following:



A short introduction about yourself and your Elementor Pro experience

Links to 3 to 5 WordPress websites you have built (live sites strongly preferred)

Your expected per-project rate

Your availability in hours per week and your time zone

One sentence on why you are looking for a long-term role rather than short-term gig work



Applications without portfolio links will not be considered.



A Note on This Opportunity

We want to be straightforward with you. We are a small agency that is growing steadily. We work with Australian small business clients and we take the quality of their websites seriously. If you are a developer who takes the same pride in your work, communicates well, and wants a stable long-term arrangement with an employer who respects your time, we think this will be a good fit for both of us.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Automotive Repair Order & Parts Estimating Specialist Needed for Busy US Auto Repair Shop
description:
We are a busy independent auto repair shop in Slidell, Louisiana, specializing in gas and diesel light/medium-duty vehicles. We are seeking a remote Automotive Repair Order & Parts Estimating Specialist to join our team.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We need someone with real automotive repair shop estimating experience who understands how to build complete, accurate repair orders inside Tekmetric for advisor review.



We work Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST. This position requires someone willing to work our business hours, which will likely be a PHP graveyard shift. During scheduled work hours, you must be exclusively available to our shop.



Prior automotive repair shop estimating experience is required. Diesel and light/medium-duty vehicle experience is strongly preferred.



Compensation will include a smaller base pay plus performance bonus opportunities based on accuracy, efficiency, completed estimates, parts profitability, and reducing missed parts that hurt gross profit.



Duties:

* Build full draft repair orders inside Tekmetric for service advisor review

* Research and add all required parts for recommended repairs

* Review repair procedures using ALLDATA, Identifix, OEM information, MOTOR, and Tekmetric canned jobs

* Identify one-time-use and non-reusable parts such as torque-to-yield bolts, seals, gaskets, clips, hardware, and other required replacement items

* Add commonly missed parts such as O-rings, fluids, filters, clamps, shop supplies, seals, gaskets, and related components

* Research parts using OEC RepairLink, PartsTech, ATD, TireHub, TireCo, and vendor catalogs

* Communicate with vendors by message or phone when needed to get answers quickly

* Ask technicians for clarification when repair recommendations are unclear

* Build complete, profitable, sellable tickets that help advisors present the job confidently

* Check availability, pricing, fitment, part numbers, and delivery options

* Compare OEM, aftermarket, and tire options when appropriate

* Help prevent missed parts, wrong parts, underpriced tickets, and profit leaks

* Document notes clearly inside Tekmetric

* Follow internal estimating procedures and shop standards

* Assist with back-office estimating and parts-related tasks as needed



Experience Required:



* Prior automotive repair shop estimating experience

* Experience building repair orders or estimates for service advisors

* Strong understanding of gas and diesel light/medium-duty vehicles

* Ability to read repair procedures and identify required supporting parts

* Familiarity with fluids, seals, gaskets, hardware, torque-to-yield bolts, and non-reusable components

* Ability to spot parts that are commonly forgotten but required to complete the job correctly

* Experience with Tekmetric preferred

* Experience with OEC RepairLink, PartsTech, ATD, TireHub, TireCo, ALLDATA, Identifix, OEM repair information, and MOTOR preferred

* Strong English reading and writing skills required

* Clear spoken English preferred for vendor calls and team communication



Hiring Process & Must Haves:

* Will require video interviews

* Must be fluent in English reading and writing

* Must be able to communicate clearly with our team during work hours

* Must have prior automotive repair shop estimating experience

* Must be comfortable working Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST

* Must have a Windows computer with current Windows OS

* Must have at least 16GB RAM

* Must have 2 monitors

* Must have reliable high-speed internet with backup connection

* Must have a noise-cancelling headset

* Must have a quiet workspace

* Must have voice chat ability for interviews and during work hours

* Must have a Payoneer account

* Must be willing to complete an estimating skills test

* Mandatory use of Timeproof



To Apply:



When applying, please use the
 subject:



“I know how to build complete repair orders with correct parts”



Please include:



* Your resume

* Your MS Teams ID

* A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

* Links to reviews from previous employers, if available

* A short explanation of your automotive estimating experience



Please answer the questions below:



1. How many years of automotive repair shop estimating experience do you have?

2. Have you built repair orders or estimates inside Tekmetric before?

3. Which systems have you used?

* Tekmetric

* OEC RepairLink

* PartsTech

* ATD

* TireHub

* TireCo

* ALLDATA

* Identifix

* OEM repair information

* MOTOR



4. Are you experienced with gas vehicles, diesel vehicles, or both?

5. Can you read a repair procedure and identify one-time-use parts, non-reusable parts, seals, gaskets, fluids, hardware, and other items needed to complete the job?

6. Give an example of a part or supply that is commonly forgotten on a repair estimate but can hurt profit if missed.

7. Are you comfortable calling or messaging vendors to confirm pricing, availability, fitment, and delivery time?

8. Are you okay working Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM CST, which may be overnight where you are?

9. Do you have a Windows computer with at least 16GB RAM?



This role is for someone who understands that a good estimate is not just “find the main part and move on.” We need someone who can think like a parts manager, support the service advisors, protect technician productivity, and help us build complete tickets the first time.

Pex Life Records is an independent label where urban music meets personal development. Founded by Wilmarck, we create high-quality tracks that resonate with the motivation of Tony Robbins, blended with the commercial sound of artists like Kanye West and Drake. Our music is purpose-driven, focusing on critical life areas: health, financial literacy, peak performance, and spirituality.

Sales & Business Development: Lead client acquisition by pitching proposals to songwriting job boards and driving profits to achieve ambitious sales targets.

100% Remote Position: Work from anywhere.

Core Availability: Sunday–Thursday, 6:30 PM EST – 3:00 AM EST.

Work/Life Balance: We offer Flexible Scheduling (choose your working days/hours) and Job Sharing options.

Prospect Response Disclaimer: Maintain key client relationships by being available for 3-5 quick, 5–15 minute responses per week within a designated 8-hour window (e.g., 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM EST).



What We're Looking For (Skills & Qualities)



We need a relentless executor with an independent spirit and high integrity.

Essential: Superior proposal writing, persistence, time management, and strong English speaking/writing skills.

Ideal Candidate: Flexible, eager to learn, competitive, and receptive to constructive criticism.



Your Path to Full-Time: The Paid Audition



We skip the traditional hiring steps and go straight to evaluating your work. The process is designed to be fair, fast, and merit-based:

1 Submit your proposal.

2 Pass a screening exercise.

3 Participate in an interview.

4 Top candidates are selected for a paid audition to ensure a mutual fit before a full-time offer is extended.

If you are ready to be a crucial leader in a high-growth, mission-driven music company, apply now!

Demonstrate your expertise in sales management (client acquisition, appointment setting, and closing calls) in your proposal. To ensure you've read these details, please begin your proposal with the phrase "purple elephant."

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Controller (Remote)
description:
About Savage Tech Australia

Savage Tech Australia is one of Australia's leading suppliers and manufacturers of accessories for GWM, Tank, BYD and other emerging off-road vehicle brands. We source products from multiple factories across China and are looking for a highly organised person to take ownership of inventory planning, forecasting and supplier coordination.

This is NOT a warehouse role. It's focused on inventory forecasting, purchasing coordination, supplier management and making sure the business never runs out of stock.

Right now our purchasing is spread across many suppliers with no central system. Your first job will be to help build that system from the ground up — a clean supplier database and a reliable ordering process — and then run it day to day.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Review Prediko inventory forecasts daily

Monitor stock levels and flag products needing reorder

Build and maintain supplier and factory databases

Create and manage purchase order schedules

Follow up with management daily on purchasing decisions

Track production progress with suppliers

Monitor container shipments and ETA dates

Maintain accurate inventory records

Produce weekly stock reports and purchasing recommendations

Identify potential stock shortages before they happen

Assist with future Odoo ERP implementation

REQUIRED SKILLS

Advanced Excel or Google Sheets

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent attention to detail

Excellent written and spoken English

Experience managing inventory, purchasing or supply chain processes

Ability to keep tasks moving without constant supervision

HIGHLY DESIRABLE

Prediko, Shopify or Odoo experience

Procurement or purchasing experience

Inventory forecasting experience

Manufacturing or supplier management experience

Experience working with Chinese suppliers

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

You'll be the central point of coordination between management, suppliers, purchasing and inventory planning — responsible for ensuring inventory decisions are made on time and critical products are reordered before they run out.

This role is full-time and aligned to Australian business hours.

HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, submit ALL of the following:

Your resume

A 2-minute video introduction

A short written response to this question: "We sell 2,000+ products sourced from many different Chinese factories, with no central ordering system today. Walk us through your first 30 days: how would you build the supplier database and purchasing process from scratch?"

An example spreadsheet, report or dashboard you have personally created

Begin your written response with the word STOCKFLOW so we know you've read this ad in full. Applications missing any of these four items will not be considered.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Developer
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Senior Full Stack AI Developer to join our core team. You will lead the architecture, development, and implementation of robust, scalable AI-driven applications, complex automation systems, and advanced multi-agent workflows.



This role is perfect for an expert software engineer who thrives on taking full ownership of end-to-end solutions. If you write exceptionally clean, scalable code across the stack, possess deep expertise in modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, multi-agent systems), have advanced hands-on experience with Python, modern web frameworks, and n8n, and are a power user of AI coding tools like Cursor or Claude Code to maximize velocity—we want you to drive our technology forward.



Responsibilities

Architecture & Full Stack Development: Architect, build, and scale resilient frontend user interfaces and high-performance backend infrastructure for our mission-critical AI applications.



Advanced AI Agent & Workflow Engineering: Design, deploy, and manage complex, high-throughput AI agents and automation workflows using n8n and custom code. Take the lead in optimizing these systems for speed and reliability.



Custom Python & Node.js Microservices: Engineer scalable microservices, complex data pipelines, and robust backend processes to handle high-volume data manipulation and advanced API integrations.



AI-Driven Development Leadership: Pioneer the use of AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) within the team to accelerate development cycles, ensure high code quality, and set the standard for AI-assisted software engineering.



Complex System Integration: Lead seamless and secure integrations connecting our platforms with enterprise third-party tools, SaaS platforms, Vector Databases, and CRMs via REST APIs, Webhooks, and OAuth.



Observability & Optimization: Design and implement comprehensive error handling, monitoring, logging, and fault-tolerance architectures to ensure 99.9% uptime and reliable AI outputs.



Mentorship: Set coding standards, conduct code reviews, and mentor junior tea
mbers to elevate the overall technical proficiency of the team.



Requirements (Must-Haves)

Proven Full Stack Expertise: 2+ years of experience in software engineering with a strong mastery of web architecture, system design, and clean code principles. Extensive experience in both frontend (React, Next.js, or Vue) and backend development.



Python & TypeScript/JavaScript Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in writing robust, production-grade code in both languages.



Deep AI & Agentic Workflow Knowledge: Strong understanding of LLM architectures, advanced prompt engineering, and proven experience implementing complex RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and multi-agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI).



Advanced n8n Experience: Deep, practical expertise in building and managing enterprise-level automation workflows in n8n (including custom node creation and handling complex data transformations).



AI Tool Proficiency: Power user of modern AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.), utilizing them to drastically improve development velocity and code architecture.



Technical Foundation: Deep expertise in REST/GraphQL APIs, advanced Webhook architecture, JSON, and complex database management (SQL, NoSQL, and Vector Databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant).



Mindset: A proactive problem-solver and strategic thinker who takes full ownership of their work. Excellent communication skills, highly adaptable, and experienced in driving projects from conception to deployment in a remote environment.



Nice to Have

Modern Frameworks: Mastery of frameworks like Next.js, FastAPI, Django, or NestJS.



AI Fine-Tuning: Experience fine-tuning open-source models or working directly with local LLMs.



Cloud & DevOps: Solid experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and serverless architectures.



Advanced Integrations: Deep experience with WhatsApp Business APIs, Twilio, or complex enterprise CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot).



Workflow Platform Breadth: Experience scaling operations using Make (Integromat), Zapier, or custom event-driven architectures.

description:
We're a marketing studio.



We ghostwrite LinkedIn posts,
 newsletters, and ads (plus other things) for B2B founders in the aviation, career consulting, finance, and home-preparedness markets.



We've already built the machine: custom AI tools (Claude plus our tailored ghostwriting skills) and a library of hundreds of client call transcripts to pull stories, ideas, and angles from.



But there's a problem with the machine, and it's the entire reason this job exists.



Our AI system produces technically accurate, on-brand copy. It'll get you the ideas.



It gets the facts right and the structure close enough...



But what it cannot do is make someone FEEL something.



The emotional storytelling, the visual detail that puts a reader inside a 
nt, the human ache that makes a post stop the scroll: that has to come from a person.



That person is who we're hiring.



So you're not starting from a blank page.



We have the AI to hand you the ideas, and we'll work together to build the content calendar.



What we need from you is the writing skill to leverage the AI and produce the one thing machines can't: emotion, story, and visual texture.



What you'll actually do:



- Mine our client's call transcripts for the 
nts mentioned above: the turning point, the fear, the win, the detail nobody else would notice

- Work with me (and ideally, over time, on your own) to draft the content calendar and the week's ideas

- Run our Claude ghostwriting skills to shape and structure the draft. The skill keeps evolving, so your input on improving the system is welcome and encouraged



Then do the part that only you can do:



- With your edits, layer in the emotional storytelling and visual, sensory detail that makes it resonate

- Fact-check every claim against the source. We write about people, companies, and industry data, so accuracy is non-negotiable

- Deliver on the content calendar a week ahead of publish date.



Volume: Minimum is 8 LinkedIn posts and ~5
s per week.



Once you're ramped and the system's dialed in, there's plenty more: sales pages, ads, additional
 work, and eventually copy for our own home-preparedness brand. This grows for the right person.



The bar: the founder reads it and goes "that's exactly how I'd say it, this gave me goosebumps."



Then I do one light proof pass and it ships.



If I'm rewriting your drafts, it's not working out...



You're a fit if you:



- Write genuinely emotional, story-driven copy in native-level English.



- This is the #1, non-negotiable requirement. Show me writing that made someone feel something.



- Have real instinct for story: you can hear a 5-minute anecdote and instantly know the emotional hook



- Use AI writing tools like Claude as a drafting partner, not a replacement for your own voice and skill



- Are obsessive about factual accuracy, attention to detail, and deadlines.



This means being reliable and consistent week over week.



- I value steady, dependable output over occasional brilliance that fades over time.



- Will be honest with me: I've hired talented writers who started strong and faded after a few weeks or months.



- I'm looking for someone consistently good who'll be with us long-term.



- Take direct feedback without getting upset, knowing we both want the same thing: content that keeps clients around long-term and grows both our incomes



Bonus if you've:



- Ghostwritten for personal brands, LinkedIn, or newsletters before

- Have any exposure to aviation, career coaching, or finance

- And experience turning interview or transcript material into content



Logistics



Remote, long-term, ongoing relationship



$800/month to start, raises available and can go up for the right person.



I'd rather find someone great and pay them more over time than start cheap and burn through people.



Mostly async, but a quick weekly call for content planning (at least early on) would be ideal



Begins with a paid trial (below)



How to apply:



Start your reply with the word CHILLS so I know you read the whole thing.



Paste ONE piece of your writing that made a reader feel something, and in one sentence, tell me what emotion you were going for and why it worked.



Here's a flat, boring fact. Rewrite it as 2-3 sentences with emotion and visual detail, the way you'd open a post:



"A pilot we coached got a job offer from a regional airline after being unemployed for 8 months."



Paid trial: Strong applicants get a strong, paid two-week trial. I'll send you call transcripts, our voice guide, and our Claude skill, and you'll produce several posts across the two weeks.



I'll of course pay you for the full two weeks. It's how I see how you actually work, and how you find out if you enjoy the system.

description:

title: META ADS MEDIA BUYER/ STRATEGIST
description:
Do not apply unless you have maximum confidence in your ability to deliver results. We will ask for proof.



Ensure you read the whole description.



Media Buyer — Meta Ads Specialist

Reports to: Head of Growth / Marketing Director

Full-time | Performance Marketing | Paid Social



About the role

We're looking for a results-driven, high-performance Media Buyer who lives and breathes Meta advertising. You've managed substantial budgets, know how to scale without blowing ROAS, and can back everything up with hard data. If you've turned paid social into a predictable growth engine, we want to talk.



At a glance



Minimum ROAS: 3.0+

Monthly spend managed: $10k+

Experience required: 2+ years Meta Ads

Track record: Proven ability to scale





Key responsibilities



Own end-to-end campaign management across Meta Ads Manager — from strategy and build to optimisation and reporting, across multiple accounts simultaneously.

Strategically scale ad spend — increasing budgets and expanding audiences while maintaining a minimum 3.0 ROAS, using proven budget-pacing and bid management techniques.

Run structured A/B and multivariate tests across creative, copy, audiences, landing pages, and offers — building a clear testing log and acting on results with speed.

Brief and collaborate with the creative team to produce high-converting ad assets — you understand what makes a Meta ad stop the scroll and drive conversions, and you can communicate that clearly.

Monitor account health daily — diagnosing performance drops, frequency issues, audience fatigue, and delivery problems before they impact results.

Build and manage full-funnel campaign structures — prospecting (TOF), retargeting (MOF/BOF), and retention — with a clear understanding of how each layer interacts.

Set up and maintain accurate tracking — Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), custom events, and UTM parameters — ensuring data integrity across all campaigns.

Deliver clear weekly and monthly performance reports with actionable insights — no vanity metrics, just ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, and the story they tell.

Stay ahead of Meta platform updates, algorithm changes, and new ad formats — proactively adapting strategy before performance is affected.





What we require



Proven spend experience: you must have personally managed Meta ad accounts at $10k+ monthly spend. You'll be asked to provide account-level results, not agency-level attribution.

Demonstrated ROAS performance: a consistent track record of sustaining 3.0+ ROAS at scale. You must be able to show this with real data.

Deep Meta Ads Manager expertise: campaign objective selection, CBO vs ABO strategy, Advantage+ campaigns, broad vs interest targeting, lookalike audiences, and manual vs automated bidding.

Scaling methodology: you have a clear, repeatable process for scaling budgets — whether through horizontal expansion, budget multipliers, or audience diversification — without destabilising campaigns.

Strong analytical skills: comfortable working with GA4, Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar attribution tools. You don't just read dashboards — you interrogate data to form hypotheses.

Tracking & measurement fluency: solid understanding of iOS 14+ attribution impact, CAPI implementation, and how to maintain reporting accuracy in a privacy-first landscape.

Creative instinct: you understand performance creative — hooks, UGC formats, video vs static — and can brief a team or give concrete, actionable feedback on ad assets.

Self-sufficient and accountable: you flag problems early, own outcomes, and don't wait for direction. You manage your accounts like they're your own business.





Nice to have



Experience running Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or YouTube alongside Meta as part of a blended paid strategy.

Experience in DTC / e-commerce environments where ROAS and blended MER are primary KPIs.

Shopify analytics experience and understanding of how paid social integrates with on-site conversion rate.

Experience managing multiple client accounts with varying spend levels, verticals, and objectives.

Meta Blueprint certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise.





Interview process



Application review — Submit a brief summary of your highest-spend account, the ROAS achieved, and how you scaled it.

Intro call (30 min) — Walk us through your experience, biggest wins, and how you think about scaling.

Paid task / case study — A short paid exercise: audit a real or sample account and present your findings and action plan.

Final interview — Deep dive with the hiring manager. We'll go through your case study and align on strategy.





Important note

We take results seriously. During the process, you'll be expected to share real performance data (anonymised if needed) that validates your experience. Candidates who cannot demonstrate their ROAS track record with data will not progress

description:

The ideal candidate will excel in guest experience and communication, manage cleaning operations effectively, and oversee property management tasks. If you have a passion for hospitality and a track record of excellence in the luxury rental market, we want to hear from you!



See below for key responsibilities pertaining to this role: 



PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

Focus: Coordinating vendor work, maintenance tracking, issue resolution, inspections, and continuous improvements to the physical space.



• Maintenance & Repairs

Coordinating vendors, responding to maintenance issues, resolving repair needs promptly, and escalating costly or urgent issues to leadership for owner approval.



• Maintenance Portal Management

Ensuring all guest-, owner-, and TL-reported tasks are tracked and resolved in the maintenance platform (Breezeway).



• Vendor Sourcing & Vetting (Ops-Focused)

Vetting new repair, maintenance, landscaping, or specialty vendors based on factors such as services offered, pricing, coverage areas, availability, etc.

Scheduling and completing quarterly walkthroughs for quality and condition tracking, as well as real-time issue resolution.



• Inventory Management & Audits (FF&E)

Overseeing key furniture, equipment, and tech items for tracking, replacement, and depreciation.



• Vendor Work Verification for Payment

Confirming completion and accuracy (and obtaining evidence) of work performed by vendors in a timely manner prior to finance initiating payment.



• Continuous Improvement of Physical Spaces

Identifying and implementing enhancements such as in-home signage, QR code instructions, or other physical/visual solutions to improve guest understanding, reduce issues, and enhance experience.



• Reporting & SOP Optimization

Creating reporting loops to identify inefficiencies, implementing recurring ops reviews, and developing and refining SOPs often to enhance operations.



GUEST EXPERIENCE

Focus: Ensuring high-touch, efficient guest support from pre-arrival through post-departure.



• Guest Communications Oversight

Managing and QA-ing guest communications (Rocket Station, HostBuddyAI, internal, etc), ensuring brand voice, scripts, escalations, accuracy and training.



• Phone Support Management

Overseeing coverage of all OpenPhone (Quo) calls/texts pertaining to guests and vendors, especially during emergencies.



• Pre-Arrival Experience

Ensuring smooth guest check-ins via codes, directions, amenities, and guidebooks, and verifying means of active communication with the guest.



• ECI & LCO Management

Managing all guest requests for early arrival or late departure, including confirming availability, communicating upsell pricing, updating internal systems, and coordinating with cleaning and maintenance teams to ensure readiness.



• In-Stay Issue Management

Overseeing resolution of guest-reported problems during their stay, including obtaining evidence and clarity on issue prior to resolution.



• Guest Concierge Services

Providing luxury touchpoints, gifts, or concierge assistance (e.g., birthdays, honeymoons, welcome surprises) on an as-needed basis.



• Review & Feedback Monitoring

Creating weekly reports summarizing public and private guest feedback with actionable takeaways to de-risk future reviews.



• Review Response Writing

Responding to all guest reviews in brand voice on Airbnb, VRBO, BDC, etc.; escalation and tracking of all non-5 star reviews.



• Guest Disputes & Escalations

Handling platform refunds, review disputes, and filing damage claims (Airbnb).



• Resolution Center Requests & Processing

Submitting and managing routine Airbnb Resolution Center actions, including security deposit requests (e.g., hot tub, pool heating) and processing guest-paid add-ons or reimbursements.



• SOP Documentation for Guest Communications

Creating and maintaining detailed reply templates, escalation paths, and guest FAQs.



• Maintain Accurate Guest-Facing Information

Ensuring all information remains up to date in welcome books, OTA fields and descriptions, instructions on use of amenities, parking and home access, etc. 



CLEANING OPERATIONS

Focus: Managing turnover schedules, vendor oversight, inventory restocking, and ensuring consistent cleaning quality across all properties.



• Cleaning Scheduling & Coordination

Managing cleaning schedules, monitoring upcoming turnovers, handling last-minute changes, and communicating with cleaning vendors.



• Cleaning Vendor Sourcing & Vetting

Researching, vetting, and recommending new cleaning partners in existing or new markets.



• Turnover Checklists

Creating, maintaining, and refining detailed turnover checklist SOPs for each property.



• Cleaning Quality Control 



• Inventory Restocking (Consumables)



SALES

Any experience with CRMs (namely Hubspot), sales funnels, managing sales pipelines, etc. 



TECHNOLOGY

Any experience with ClickUp, 
, Notion, product management, or engineering / technical background.



**Must have excellent English language proficiency (verbal, reading, writing)



Please answer the following questions (submissions without answers will not be considered):  



1. Describe your experience in hospitality management / short term rentals - what positions have you worked in? What tools and technologies do you have experience with?



2. What do you consider to be your biggest professional achievement?



3. Convince us you are a self-starter. That is, you take initiative to solve problems even when given limited information.



4. What is your current availability and number of hours per week desired? Please list in the following bulleted format if available only specific days of the week / hours: (Example) - Monday - 16:30 - 01:30 (EST) - Tuesday - 08:30 - 17:30 (EST). 

*If open to any schedule, reply "Open to needs of organization."



5. What would make you want to stay at a company forever?



Thank you,



Brian Foster, CEO

Travel Luxe Vacation Rentals

We're a US-based real estate wholesaling company, closing ~20 single-family deals per year in Alabama. We're expanding our cold calling operation and looking for ONE experienced full-time cold caller to join our team long-term. The right person will grow with us as we scale.



This is a long-term position, not a short gig. We pay on time, every time, and we reward performance.



**What You'll Do**



- Call homeowners from provided lead lists through Mojo Dialer(1100 dials/day with a triple-line dialer)

- Qualify motivated sellers using our proven script

- Collect property details: condition, timeline, asking price, motivation

- Tag and update lead status accurately in our CRM

- Set warm appointments for our acquisitions team

- Follow up consistently with warm leads



**Required Experience**



- Minimum 2 years of US real estate cold calling, specifically for wholesaling or investor acquisitions (not generic telemarketing)

- Hands-on experience with at least one of: Mojo, CallTools, Batch Dialer, REsimpli, ReadyMode, and triple-line dialer

- Clear, neutral, confident English - comfortable with US homeowners

- Strong objection handling: "not interested," "how did you get my number," price pushback

- Reliable high-speed internet (minimum 25 Mbps), quiet workspace, USB headset

- Available 8 hours/day, overlapping with US business hours (CST)



Pay Structure



- Base: $3.5/hr (negotiable based on experience and recorded call samples)

- $100 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment under 15k)

- $200 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment between 15k and 30k)

- $350 per deal that closes from your lead (Assignment above 30k)



To Apply - You Must Include All 4 (applications missing any will be ignored):



1. Voice recording (30–60 seconds): Pretend you're calling a homeowner. Open the call, handle this objection: "I'm not interested, how did you get my number?" - record yourself responding naturally.

2. Real estate experience: List the companies you've cold-called for, role, dates, and what state(s) / list types you called. Provide at least one verifiable reference (name +
).

3. Tools: Which dialers and CRMs have you used? How long with each?

4. Availability: Your time zone, hours/day available, and earliest start date.



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



What We're NOT Looking For



- Agencies or teams (we want to hire ONE person directly)

- General customer service or appointment setters with no RE experience

- Anyone who can't provide a voice sample on a real wholesaling objection



If you've made it this far and you're a real wholesaling cold caller, we want to hear from you. The first couple of days are a paid trial. Perform, and you have a long-term home with us.

title: REMOTE GRAPHIC DESIGNER FOR UK COMPANY
description:
OVERVIEW 

- Position: Graphic Designer

- Location: Remote

- Contract: Full Time

- Working Hours: 35 hours per week

- Schedule: 7 hours per day, 5 days per week

- Working Days: Flexible, to be agreed in advance

- Monthly Salary: $300–$400 USD + bonuses





ABOUT THE ROLE

We are currently seeking a full-time Graphic Designer to join our company and help bring our brand and products to life through high-quality visual content. 



We are a London-based e-commerce business selling products on Amazon, eBay, and our own website. This is a fully remote position, and you’ll be working closely with our team to design product listing images, Amazon A+ Content, product packaging, social media graphics, and other visual materials that help drive sales and build a strong brand identity.



We're looking for someone creative, reliable, and detail-oriented—someone who can take ideas and turn them into clean, effective, and eye-catching designs. If you’re someone who loves designing, enjoys having creative freedom, and wants to be part of a fast-moving company where your work will have a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.





RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design high-converting product listing images for Amazon, eBay, website, etc.

- Create A+ Content and brand story sections for Amazon listings

- Design eye-catching and on-brand product packaging

- Test and optimise different main image variations to improve click-through rates

- Enhance product photos by adjusting lighting, colour, sharpness, and overall composition

- Remove backgrounds and add visual effects to make products stand out

- Ensure all images meet the technical and visual standards of each e-commerce platform

- Collaborate with the team to maintain a consistent brand look across all visuals



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 years of proven experience in graphic design, ideally in e-commerce

- Experience using AI image generation tools

- Proficiency in design software, such as Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.

- Strong portfolio showcasing product image design, packaging, and branding work

- Excellent English communication skills (both written and verbal)

- Reliable internet connection and a functional remote workspace

- Well-organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks at once

- Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and looking for a long-term role

- Available to work 5 days per week



WHY JOIN US

- 2 weeks of paid vacation per year

- Monthly & year-end bonuses based on performance

- Potential to increase hours and salary over time based on performance

- Opportunity for long-term growth and promotion within the company

- 100% remote – work from anywhere, as long as you're focused during your agreed working hours



HOW TO APPLY

If you’re interested in this role and meet the requirements listed above, please apply by filling out the application form at the link below. We’re looking forward to hearing from you!







NOTE 1: Only applications submitted through the form will be considered.



NOTE 2: Please make sure your portfolio includes examples of product images, e-commerce graphics, Amazon listing images, packaging design, or similar work.
